title: Austin's Future Funding: Budget Breakdown
summary:
Here's a concise look at the August 21, 1996 Austin City Council agenda:

*   The main focus of the meeting was an in-depth review of the proposed 1996-97 operating budget.
*   City staff delivered detailed presentations on funding for essential services, including Water, Wastewater, Aviation, Drainage, and Solid Waste.
*   The budget discussions also highlighted the financial plan for the Convention Center.
*   Proposed allocations for Public Safety and Youth, Family, and Neighborhood Vitality programs were part of the budget deliberations.
